channel.provenance: NOAA NWM / NextGen hydrofabric v2.0.1 conventions as observed in the t-route test fabric LowerColorado_NGEN_v201.gpkg (6971 reaches): Manning n by stream order (0.06 for orders 1-2, 0.055 for 3-4, 0.05 for 5 and up), compound n = 2 n, bottom width = 0.6 top width, compound top width = 3 top width, bed slope floor 1e-5, MusK 3600 s, MusX 0.2, Qi 0, no channel loss. Top width = 2.44 DA^0.34 (m, DA in km2), the bankfull regression of Blackburn-Lynch, Agouridis and Barton (2017, JAWRA 53(4)) that the same fabric follows (least-squares fit over the 6971 reaches: 2.425 DA^0.338). Side slope = 0.7836 DA^-0.1456, a least-squares fit over the same 6971 reaches (no published formula located).

level_pool.provenance: Constants as in every complete lakes row of the NOAA t-route test fabric LowerColorado_NGEN_v201.gpkg (19 of 20 rows): WeirC 0.4, WeirL 10 m, OrificeC 0.1, OrificeA 1 m2, Dam_Length 10, ifd 0.9; and its elevation layout, LkMxE - WeirE = 0.15 D and LkMxE - OrificeE = D for a pool depth D. Here the weir crest is the DEM water surface at the lake outlet (normal pool), and D = 2 x the HydroLAKES mean depth (mean/maximum depth of about 0.5 for typical lake basins, Hakanson 1981, A Manual of Lake Morphometry). Reviewed with the reservoirs owner before use outside the proof domains.
